ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent guilty pleas in the Feeding Our Future case and explore the broader issue of fraud in Minnesota.
questions: What are the underlying causes of fraud in Minnesota?
How can fraud be prevented in the future?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe that this story has the potential to shed light on a critical issue affecting the state of Minnesota. By following the money and examining the patterns of fraud, we can gain a deeper understanding of the root causes of this problem and identify potential solutions.
